results.title: Supplier = Supnew vs All Suppliers
results.steps: Select supplier Supnew (Supnew), click Go; then All Suppliers, click Go.
results.expected: Supnew shows only its own items, all of which also appear under All Suppliers.
results.actual: Supnew: 219 rows; All Suppliers: 237 rows; Supnew items missing from All: []

results.title: Supplier chip and grid agree after Go
results.expected: Only the Supnew chip is shown and the grid lists Supnew rows.

results.title: Multiple suppliers (Supnew + Sup111023)
results.steps: Add a second supplier to Supnew, click Go.
results.expected: Rows of both suppliers are listed (union of the two single-supplier results).
results.actual: Automation error, case skipped: Supplier suggestion 'Sup111023 (Sup111023)' not found in []

results.title: Removing the supplier chip returns all suppliers
results.steps: Remove the supplier chip, click Go.
results.expected: Behaves like All Suppliers or prompts to select a supplier.
results.actual: No supplier chip: 237 rows; All Suppliers 237 rows
